piston_n16.units: rad, absolute (the RELATIVE form exists only inside the GR00T processor)

axis_identity.value: dataset radians == twin joint radians (open 0, closing +); thumb_yaw pinned at -0.1 in the data -> declared clip to the twin open endpoint
axis_identity.evidence: hand-req-01 B PASS on rod30 is a donor-twin result; the recorded hand model is UNRESOLVED (H2 items 15/16)

piston_n16.note: radian identity, per-axis twin endpoints, clip_declared; NO +0.2 rad gain; the closure-preserving alternative (normalized to 1.7) FAILED hand-an-02-AB and is not offered

rules: a consumer may run a route as qualified only when every field it needs is VERIFIED on its target; otherwise exploratory=True must be declared and is recorded in the declaration and hash
no contract exists for target installed_e2 while any installed field is UNRESOLVED
UNRESOLVED fields carry no value; NOMINAL values are manual/product-page figures, never measurements
the twin velocity cap (1.0 rad/s on the drive joints) is a twin property, never an installed-hand speed
